title: Ocean Reclaimers
description: A casual top-down arcade ocean-cleanup game. Sail a small boat around Coral Bay, scoop up floating plastic, unload at the station, upgrade your vessel and bring the bay back to life. A fictional, simplified game.

defaultCaptions.x: Ocean Reclaimers: scoop plastic, chain combos and clear Coral Bay in this cozy arcade cleanup game.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Play Ocean Reclaimers, a cozy arcade game about cleaning up Coral Bay one bottle at a time.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Ocean Reclaimers - a small browser arcade game where you sail, scoop plastic, upgrade your boat and revive a bay.
defaultCaptions.discord: Ocean Reclaimers is playable in the browser: sail, collect, combo, upgrade, and clear Coral Bay.
